scenarios.scenario: Fork PR or other external event triggers a write-capable run
scenarios.rationale: Only schedule and workflow_dispatch triggers; no pull_request/pull_request_target (grep count 0). workflow_dispatch needs repo write access.

scenarios.scenario: Push collision with narrative (23:00) / liqtide (23:30) jobs on main
scenarios.rationale: 22:00 UTC start (60/90 min offset, ~2-3 min runtime), own concurrency group, 3-attempt pull --rebase + push retry; files are disjoint so rebases don't conflict.

scenarios.scenario: Job commits files outside the archive
scenarios.rationale: git add api/data/cache/onchain/ only; commit skipped when the staged diff is empty.

scenarios.scenario: Malicious or garbage provider data lands on main
scenarios.rationale: Adapters drop null/NaN/negative values; stored as Parquet numbers only (no executable content); future dates dropped; history older than 14 days is frozen (drift counted, not written); worst case is wrong numbers inside the window, visible via revised/previous_value and revertible via git.

scenarios.scenario: Supply-chain compromise via third-party actions or deps
scenarios.rationale: Only actions/checkout@v4 and astral-sh/setup-uv@v3, same as existing snapshot workflows; uv sync uses the committed uv.lock; no new dependencies.
At most 16 small Parquet files (12 growthepie + 4 L2BEAT); rewritten only when a row is inserted or revised.

scenarios.scenario: Rate-limit ban of the runner IP
scenarios.rationale: 16 requests/night, 6 s spacing (~10 req/min); failures isolate per series and exit 2 just warns.
